But the new public gate_problems says "What [`gate`](@ref) refuses for" while its code runs `isdir(RoundFiles.rounds_dir(cfg)) || return (fatal, problems)`, which is clean. gate returns 2 in that case (ROUND.DIR) and on a self_verify failure. verdicts.what_would_bite: GBGCodingTools.gate_problems(cfg) with .gbg/rounds/ absent and instruments enabled, or with self verify failing, returns (false, []), which reads as nothing to refuse, where gate(cfg) returns 2. docs_build_skipped only calls it after code == 1, so today's caller is safe. A direct caller of the documented public binding is not.

verdicts.evidence: ext/GBGCodingToolsDocumenterExt.jl: "A round of a docs instrument freezes the build (ARCHITECTURE D9)." D9 states it: "either gate refusing only because a round of a docs instrument is open prints `makedocs: SKIPPED` ... `GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP` restores the refusal". RULE.INST.FROZEN_MIDROUND: "An instrument is never changed mid-round; a change is its own commit and release" -- nothing about builds. The new citation is the one that states the skip.

DocLints.jl: `all(p -> first(p) == :open, last(gate_problems(...))) || return String[]`; docstring: "a round whose fixes were committed without it, fails the build." Gate.jl pushes `:committed` only after `:open` for the same round, only when `!in_ci`, and skips GBG_ROUND rounds (`r.name in ignored && continue`). The gate already makes it exit 1: "the fixes were committed without the round". Only a bare local build changes.

47db044's only Design.jl hunk is docstring text: '-which hat's own rubric should have caught it' -> '+which hat's persona should have caught it'. The message lists it under 'cold-reader#1-4 ...; "the rubric" named', and the same commit swept 'the rubric' -> 'the docstring rubric' in Reflection.jl. 'persona' is the bound term: GBGCodingTools.jl:21 'A **hat** is one persona of the check-consistency panel'; Design.jl:155 writes h["persona"].

Gate.jl: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes both the `:open` push and `if !in_ci && ... push!(problems, :committed ...)`, so GBG_ROUND builds (Rounds.jl:151/188/297, Passes.jl:530) and CI never see :committed. DocLints.jl: `all(p -> first(p) == :open, ...) || return String[]`. All prose says the skip is for 'refusing only because a round of a docs instrument is open'; IMPLEMENTATION.md:91 'A bare ... docs/make.jl under an open round is refused by design'.

Gate.jl gate_problems: `r.name in ignored && continue` precedes the :committed push, itself guarded by `!in_ci`. Every in-round build (Rounds.jl run_under_round 94/151/188/297; Passes.jl 530) exports GBG_ROUND; release and deep doctor set GBG_DOCS_NO_SKIP. check-consistency PROTOCOL: "a bare julia --project=docs docs/make.jl under an open round is refused by the gate, by design." Only a bare local mid-round build with dirty round files changes: exit-0 skip (nothing built) becomes a named refusal.
